method: Hand analysis: EPA AQS 2023 hourly SO2, Open-Meteo modelled wind, TCEQ Galveston County reports. Episodes at a fixed 5 ppb floor, split on gaps over 4 h. Matching on time overlap (2 h either side) plus SO2 listed.
so2_hours_2023_basis: local standard time, matching how the AQS yearly file is filtered; counting on UTC years gives 8003, because the 2022 file's last local hours fall into 2023 UTC
